summary: Sparking Dawn (dating) — backend + frontend fully working. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering discover filtering (man/woman/all + exclusions), swipe like/pass/self/unknown, seeded likes_back matches (spark-1,2,4,5,7,8,10) vs non-likes_back (spark-3,6,9), real two-user mutual match, profile save (valid + invalid gender), and matches list (content + descending sort). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): register → /district/sparking-dawn shows both feature rows; feature-I'm looking for women routes to /sparking-dawn?seeking=woman with correct deck; seeking-man/woman/all, btn-like, btn-pass, view-matches, edit-dating-profile all present and functional. Match overlay ('It's a Spark!') fires after liking Isolde (spark-1) with match-view + match-continue; /sparking-dawn/matches shows the matched card (Isolde Vayne, 29). Profile editor at /sparking-dawn/profile has dp-gender-*, dp-seek-*, dp-age, dp-tagline, dp-bio, dp-save; save persists and routes back to the deck.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — origin appears to be a shared component (not the Sparking Dawn screens, which correctly use style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}). Reference: check ForgeButton/BrassText/other shared components.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props on the Sparking Dawn card to boxShadow to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
Optional: locate and update the shared component that still passes pointerEvents as a prop (not style) to remove the second deprecation warning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: POST /api/auth/register returns 201 (not 200); test helpers must accept both. Frontend routes: /(auth)/register and /(auth)/login with testIDs register-name/email/password/submit and login-*. Deep-linking to /district/sparking-dawn works after registration. Match creation is deterministic against seeds spark-1,2,4,5,7,8,10 (likes_back:true) — reliable path to trigger the match-overlay in UI is to select seeking-woman then click btn-like once or twice (spark-1 Isolde is a likes_back woman).
